name: web3
description: Read-only EIP-1193 wallet inspection and unsigned withdrawal intents. Testnet by default; no private keys; nothing signed or broadcast without explicit consent.
notes: A default scaffold is READ-ONLY and must compile, typecheck, test and run with src/wallet/signing.ts and src/wallet/broadcast.ts absent.

The two consent-gated files are withheld unless the operator passes --i-understand-this-signs-transactions at generation time. That flag is a statement of ownership, not a password and not an approval prompt.

src/index.ts.tmpl reaches the gated modules only through a dynamic import whose specifier is held in a variable, so TypeScript does not try to resolve a file that is not there. A static import would break the default build.
No file in this template contains a private key, a mnemonic, a keystore, a key derivation, a scheduler, a retry loop, or a mainnet configuration.
No RPC URL, API key, project id or secret is bundled. RPC_URL ships empty; config.ts refuses to guess an endpoint and skips reads instead.
The default and only configured chains are testnets (Sepolia, Holesky). assertDefaultChainIsTestnet() runs at import time and throws otherwise.

src/wallet/intent.ts.tmpl builds unsigned, expiring withdrawal intents: BigInt amounts, isAddress validation, self-send rejection, a one-hour maximum lifetime, canonical sorted-key serialisation and a keccak256 display hash. It never signs and never sends.

Status of anything generated from this template is SCAFFOLD. Its presence is not evidence that a capability is built, tested or operational, and running it does not make any Melodiespark capability operational.

The example destination 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000dEaD is the standard burn address, used only as an obviously-fake validation fixture. It appears in tests and in one labelled line of the README, and nowhere else.
template.json is never emitted. The 'variables' object is empty: every {{TOKEN}} this template uses is supplied by the CLI.
